summary: Rebuilt test artifacts from scratch for the redesigned KIIT Safety Connect dispatch app (auth/civilian/officer/response-team roles, live dispatch, GIS, comms, escalation). Removed 9 stale check files that referenced the removed gate account / old prototype UI. Rewrote backend auth tests (old defaults no longer matched: signup now defaults to CIVILIAN, gate account removed, portal_role gating enforced) and added a dispatch lifecycle + escalation backend test file. Added 8 new browser checks, one per acceptance-matrix criterion. All backend tests (5) and browser checks (8) pass.
action_items: None outstanding. Note: httpx test clients must re-set the session cookie without the Secure flag to work over the plain-http localhost test transport (COOKIE_SECURE=true is correct for the real https deployment); documented via login_client() helper in backend/tests/conftest.py for future test authors.

checks.criterion: Role-secure authentication matches the Web-Shooter portals
checks.name: test_tscheck_auth.py
checks.evidence: POST /auth/signup -> 200 role=CIVILIAN; POST /auth/login wrong-portal (OFFICER) with civilian creds -> 403; correct portal -> 200; seeded officer control@kiit.ac.in correct portal -> 200 role=OFFICER, mismatched portal (RESPONSE_TEAM) -> 403

checks.criterion: Role-secure authentication matches the Web-Shooter portals
checks.name: civilian-signup-opens-civilian-only
checks.evidence: Signup -> civilian-dashboard visible; same creds via officer portal -> 403, stays on auth-page; civilian portal -> succeeds; seeded control@kiit.ac.in via officer portal -> control-room-page visible

checks.criterion: Civilian can submit and track a mapped incident
checks.name: civilian-reports-incident-and-tracks-status
checks.evidence: POST /dispatch/reports -> 201; civilian-report-{id} card visible with title, 'Sent to control room' NEW status text, and Live/Polling fallback indicator

checks.criterion: Control room receives and coordinates reports in real time
checks.name: officer-queue-acknowledges-and-scores-teams
checks.evidence: New report visible in dispatch-report-{id} queue; PATCH .../status ACKNOWLEDGED -> 200; team recommendation cards show distance km, AVAILABLE/BUSY/OFF_DUTY, active workload

checks.criterion: Control room receives and coordinates reports in real time

checks.evidence: GET /dispatch/reports/{id}/recommendations -> 200, each item has team/score/distance_km/capability_match/reasoning; Campus Fire Unit capability_match true for Fire Hazard category

checks.criterion: Officer can assign overlapping responders with one accountable primary team

checks.evidence: team-assignment-{id} visible only for the assigned fire team; TEAM_ACCEPTED -> EN_ROUTE -> RESOLVED all 200; final timeline statuses exactly [NEW,ACKNOWLEDGED,TEAM_ASSIGNED,TEAM_ACCEPTED,EN_ROUTE,RESOLVED] with actor_role covering CIVILIAN/OFFICER/RESPONSE_TEAM

checks.criterion: Incident communication and fallback escalation work

checks.evidence: Civilian and officer messages both posted via POST .../messages and rendered in incident-comms-{id}; POST .../escalate -> 200, status back to ACKNOWLEDGED, assigned_team_ids=[], primary_team_id=null

checks.criterion: Incident communication and fallback escalation work

checks.criterion: Officer GIS and patrol intelligence remain usable
checks.name: officer-gis-and-geofence-tools-work
checks.evidence: map-canvas loads; geofence draw (3 map clicks) -> POST /geofences 200 -> card visible; PUT edit rename reflected in card; DELETE removes card; hotspot search + KIIT focus + dark style switch work; incident-detail-drawer opens/closes from hotspot matrix

checks.criterion: Public preview security and presentation meet hackathon expectations
checks.name: public-preview-loads-and-blocks-old-credentials
checks.evidence: https://kiit-incidents.preview.emergentagent.com loads auth-page (no blank page); prototype label visible; old gate@kiit.ac.in/kiit-gis-2025 -> 401 rejected; new civilian signup + report creation succeed end-to-end with no strict-console failures

checks.criterion: Public preview security and presentation meet hackathon expectations
checks.name: curl security headers probe
checks.evidence: curl -I https://kiit-incidents.preview.emergentagent.com/api/incidents shows strict-transport-security, content-security-policy, x-content-type-options: nosniff, permissions-policy, referrer-policy headers present

notes: Removed stale artifacts from a prior app version (campus-map-controls-respond, export-share-logout-controls-work, incident-filters-update-feed, invalid-credentials-show-error, kiit-branding-visible, kiit-login-reaches-control-room, officer-login-survives-reload, officer-signup-reaches-control-room, risk-register-opens-intelligence) since they referenced the removed gate@kiit.ac.in account and an earlier UI that no longer exists.
8 acceptance-matrix criteria covered exactly (matches briefing count); 5 backend + 8 browser artifacts = 13 checks total, several criteria have both lanes as they are API-backed UI flows.

Fixed a real test-authoring gotcha, not an app bug: httpx test client withholds Secure-flagged cookies on plain http://localhost transport; real browsers treat localhost as a secure context so this does not affect actual users.
